dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Bills (9-1) Week 12 Briefing: Friday Injury Report Ahead of Chiefs
bullets: Injury & Practice Status: DT T.J. Sanders (shoulder), CB Christian Benford (groin), and LB Dorian Williams (calf) logged limited practice reps Friday [Pro Football Rumors](https://www.profootballrumors.com/2026/11/nfl-practice-squad-updates-11-24-26).

Week 12 Chiefs Outlook: Joe Brady and DC Jim Leonhard open installation for the Kansas City Chiefs (8-2, BUF -3, HC Andy Reid, OC Eric Bieniemy & DC Steve Spagnuolo (Highmark Stadium))—a unit ranked #1 in Total Yards / Game (396.9 yds) as Buffalo prepares for a pivotal AFC matchup [Chris Trapasso](https://www.buffalorumblings.com/buffalo-bills-analysis/146410/joe-bradys-buffalo-bills-need-a-vintage-sean-mcdermott-performance-vs-chiefs) [buffalobills.com Official](https://www.buffalobills.com/news/we-ve-got-to-be-at-our-best-buffalo-s-offense-gears-up-to-take-on-the-kansas-city-chiefs-stifling-defense).

AFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 9-1 (1st in AFC East • #1 Seed in AFC), Buffalo carries a 99.9% postseason projection, 98.8% AFC East division title mark, and 54.5% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [Joe Buscaglia](https://bsky.app/profile/joebuscaglia.bsky.social/post/3n35eubm3ek2h).

Around the Beat: Thanksgiving Day is finally here, and with it comes a featured course of football all day long [Matt Byham](https://www.buffalorumblings.com/buffalo-bills-discussion/146400/lions-vs-bears-cowboys-vs-eagles-thanksgiving-day-nfl-fan-discussion).

Statistical Profile & Matchup Edge: Through Week 11, Buffalo ranks #2 in Points / Game (31.3), #9 in Points Allowed / Game (20.8), #19 in Turnover Differential (-1), giving Joe Brady and Jim Leonhard a clear benchmark ahead of Thu, Nov 26, 8:20 PM EST • NFL TV at [object Object] against the Kansas City Chiefs [buffalobills.com Official](https://www.buffalobills.com/news/it-s-always-a-challenge-how-the-bills-are-preparing-for-a-high-powered-kansas-city-chiefs-offense).
